parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Currently, only scaling groups are supported. Set the value to scalinggroup.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag information of the resource.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

Once specified, the tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Propagate
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the tag is a propagated tag. Valid values:

- true: The tags on the scaling group are propagated only to instances that are about to be created, and are not propagated to instances that are already running in the scaling group.
- false: The tags on the scaling group are not propagated to instances.

Default value: false.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
